if p_small:

    rows = [sum(b[0] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']) for p in p_small]

    print(f"Purple circle center: ~({center_row}, {center_col})")

    print("\nObjects after:")

        if 5 <= n['pixels'] < 100:
            center = (sum(b[0] for b in n['boundary'])//len(n['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in n['boundary'])//len(n['boundary']))
            print(f"  color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, center~{center}")
